local_review_provenance.camera_and_transform_rules: Production applyModelTransform, normalizeModel and frameCameraToBox, with the workflow’s view direction and framing defaults. Each variant starts from a prepared source-scene clone; no rotation or normalization accumulates.
local_review_provenance.appearance: Production appearanceForSlug selector and source texture/vertex-color preservation logic. No new authored maps, recoloring or geometry edits.
local_review_provenance.sampling_difference_from_workflow: Lower raster sampling resolution only; transforms, camera aspect/rules and production appearance profiles match the workflow.
local_review_provenance.source_delivery: Existing local optimized previews hash-match their recorded public R2 preview asset; raw source archive not downloaded.
